anna: Quick announce  Private Deploy 3.2 GA planned for 2026-09-10. Focus: export authorization and timeboxed auditor keys for on-prem/VPC. Short bullets:
- Auditor Keys: customers can register auditor public keys with TTLs so auditors get timeboxed access to exported bundles.
- Export Authorization: any programmatic export now requires an approver token (console or signed offline bundle).
- Offline-first: for air-gapped installs we provide signed approval bundles customers can apply locally; no egress needed.

mira: TL;DR for SEs: no forced changes; new tenants default to export-auth=required. Existing tenants keep current behavior for 45 days post-GA.

ben: Question  how visible are auditor keys in export manifests?
anna: Auditor IDs and key fingerprints are included; actual keys never leave customer vaults (we store wrapped keys).

tony: Action items:
- SE outreach for top-25 regulated customers (mira).
- Docs: add approval bundle walkthrough + console screenshots (docs-bot).
- Security: review wrapped-key lifecycle and signature scheme (sec-bot).
- Ops: schedule canary and webhook runner for escrow endpoints (ops-bot).

docs-bot: Docs PR targeted EOD Tue with CLI and console examples.
